entries.title: Job 38:2
segments: When men undertake to sit in judgment on the works and ways of God, or to explain the reasons of all his dealings, they generally darken their own minds and the minds of others by words without knowledge.

entries.title: Job 38:3
segments: Gird up now thy loins; summon up all thy courage, resolution, and wisdom.

entries.title: Job 38:5
segments: Stretched the line upon it? as a carpenter in building a house.

entries.title: Job 38:6
segments: The works and ways of God in creating and governing the world, though ordered in infinite wisdom and goodness, are far above and beyond the most enlarged and exalted conceptions of men, and call for adoring gratitude, admiration, and praise.

entries.title: Job 38:7
segments: Sons of God; the angelic hosts.

entries.title: Job 38:8
segments: Shut up the sea; set bounds to it, that it cannot pass over.

entries.title: Job 38:12
segments: The regularity of day and night, and the benefits they impart to the human family, are constant evidences of the goodness of God; and lay men under ever new obligations to acknowledge, trust in, and obey him.

entries.title: Job 38:13
segments:
Take hold of the ends of the earth; shine upon every part of it. 
 
  Might be shaken out of it; driven away by the light from their deeds of darkness.

entries.title: Job 38:14
segments:
It is turned; the whole earth assumes a fresh, new form; like the wax under the seal. 
 
  And they stand as a garment; all things on the earth's surface stand forth like a new and beauteous robe.

entries.title: Job 38:15
segments: From the wicked their light is withholden; because the darkness of night is their light; that is, it furnishes their opportunity to do evil deeds: the coming of the morning is to them the shadow of death.
The high arm shall be broken; their power to do mischief is prevented by the approaching light of day.

entries.title: Job 38:16
segments: The greatness, wisdom, power, and goodness of God, are seen in the sea, in the inexhaustible treasures it contains, and in the facilities it affords for the conversation, health, prosperity, and happiness of man.

entries.title: Job 38:17
segments: The gates of death; the passage to the invisible world, the world of spirits.

entries.title: Job 38:19
segments: Light--and--darkness; could Job explain their origin, nature, and effects?--things which existed and operated long before he was born.

entries.title: Job 38:22
segments: The snow and the hail, the storm and the tempest, the lightning, thunder, rain, dew, and sunshine--all governed by exact and immutable laws, which no man can cntrol or evade--proclaim the omnipotence, and show forth the presence of an all-surrounding God.

entries.title: Job 38:23
segments: Against the time of trouble--battle and war?; against the day when I come forth as a warrior to fight against my enemies with great hail-stones.
, etc.

entries.title: Job 38:24
segments: Which scattereth the east wind; or, By what way is the east wind scattered?

entries.title: Job 38:25
segments: Divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters; distributed the overflowing waters of the clouds into their proper channels.  This is a figurative description of the distributions of rain, borrowed from the manner in which the eastern husbandman irrigates his land by distributing the water through it in proper channels.

entries.title: Job 38:30
segments: Are hid; beneath their icy covering.

entries.title: Job 38:31
segments:
The sweet influences of Pleiades; the sweet infuences of Spring which accompany the rising of Pleiades.  Pleiades is the seven stars which rise in the spring of the year.  Some render this clause, "Canst thou bind the hands of Pleiades?"  Loosing and binding the constellations means making their movements and influences subject to our will. 
 
  Orion; a constellation of stars on the equinoctial. 
 
The nature, number, courses, and influences of the stars, though perfectly known to Him who calleth them all by their names and employs them to accomplish his purposes, can be but very imperfectly comprehended by the most intelligent and wisest of the children of men.

entries.title: Job 38:32
segments:
Mazzaroth; the twelve signs of the zodiac. 
 
  Arcturus with his sons; a constellation of stars now called the Great Bear, and revolving around the North star.

entries.title: Job 38:33
segments:
The ordinances of heaven? the laws which govern the heavenly bodies. 
 
  The dominion; the influence they have upon the earth.

entries.title: Job 38:36
segments: All the knowledge and wisdom which men possess, above the beasts of the field, or the fowls of the air, come from God.  Let not the wise man glory in his wisdom, neither let the mighty man glory in his might; let not the rich man glory in his riches; but let him that glorieth, glory in the Lord.

entries.title: Job 38:37
segments: Stay the bottles of heaven; or, cause to lie down as a bottle, in emptying it; that is, pour forth rain from the clouds.

entries.title: Job 38:38
segments: When the dust--cleave fast together; as in a time of drought. Another rendering: "When the dust is melted into mire, and the clods cleave fast together;" that is, are reduced by rain to a mass of cohering clay.  This is then to be regarded as the effect of emptying the bottles of heaven.
